info.description: A service offering published on the marketing site. Content is edited in the Strapi admin by non-technical team members and rendered by the React frontend.

shortDescription.description: Card teaser shown on the Services page grid.

longDescription.description: Full service copy, rendered in the expandable detail on the Services page.

icon.description: Icon reference — must match the frontend Icon component's icon names.

features.description: Key features, shown as a checklist on the service card.

startingFrom.description: Optional price or engagement type, e.g. "From $18,000" or "Fixed-scope engagement".

testimonials.description: Client quotes about this service (inverse of testimonial.service).

contactSubmissions.description: Contact form leads interested in this service (inverse of contact-submission.service).

order.description: Manual sort order on the Services page (ascending).
